purpose: Fresh bounded resource verification after correcting launch-receipt contradictions; no source changes
head: a39c2ea2b7782f594f3b61d08bd4573e316c1d7a
data_accounting: All measured host task artifacts and worker allocation are charged conservatively to the 4 GiB data budget; log files are a separately measured subset, not the entire artifact total. Existing host caches plus worker allocation remain below the 20 GiB build budget.
guards: Safe paired replay guards: readonly root; sole volume /work; accounted /tmp and /dev. Sampled stop guards, not quotas; monitoring errors stop the workload. Docker logs are rotated at 20m x 5.
stop_action: Host kills entire owned container, then Popen.kill()/wait retires only its Docker client if still unreaped. Inner runner signals campaign group only while its leader remains unreaped; after reaping, whole-container termination owns lingering descendants. No post-reap process-group signal.
estimated_growth: 15 bounded focused tests, no downloads or model work; under 10 MiB generated data and the explicit output allowances above.
